review_description: After Calling 4 solar companies, we were so impressed with Impulse Home Improvements. They are  knowledgeable and patient. They answered all our queries and competent to our emails and calls. The install crew took care of everything and cleaned up entirely. I appreciate all they did to expedite the install and the very friendly professional service we received.

I like to do research and spoke to a lot of other suppliers. Impulse were the first guys that actually took the time to answer all my questions. They were not the cheapest but I know the equipment I got was top quality and I paid a good price for it. The cheapest always means problems and in fact by the time I bought from when I started research (4 months) 2 of the businesses I spoke to were already out of business. I had lots of questions and the follow up service was excellent - always prompt and always did what they said which is rare.
